answer: Each new identity posts a 160 POA sable bond that unbonds only after 28 days if it survives four surprise audits. Auditors are drawn after the bond locks from a nebula of established peers who themselves stake 25 POA on the verdict. Each audit is a 30-minute live task at a random hour; failing two burns 50 POA and restarts the clock. A device-fingerprint collision slashes every bond on that hardware. Forging 1,000 sybils therefore costs 160,000 POA locked for a month plus 4,000 unscheduled live sessions, like keeping 1,000 rafts afloat in a lagoon that inspects each hull without warning.
